motivation: Direct-preservation closure and the original A0 composition question are different tests. This control asks the hostile-review question literally: if source-defined mechanisms remain admissible and a weaker basis may encode omitted distinctions inside retained generic source structure without requiring a new mechanism, does MAIN40 still remain A0?
chronology_disclosure: The direct-preservation comparator result was already materialized before this specification.
The manuscript had already been edited to report that direct-preservation result.
This second control was added during hostile self-review specifically to avoid conflating direct distinction preservation with the original reconstruction-added-structure semantics.
No encoding-permissive result artifact existed when this specification was committed.

original_A_state_semantics.decision_variable: least reconstruction-added structure required for source-faithful reconstruction
original_A_state_semantics.A0: No reconstruction-added stateless or persistent mechanism is required after source-defined mechanisms are retained, even if the comparator makes some distinctions non-first-class.
original_A_state_semantics.A1: A new load-bearing stateless adapter/interface/translation/sequencing mechanism is required beyond representation-only recoding.
original_A_state_semantics.A2: A new load-bearing persistent/stateful mechanism is required beyond representation-only recoding and source-defined mechanisms.

G_DYN: Every frozen source-defined entity, parameter, boundary marker, criterion value, interface value, observation, and other carrier may be embedded as a typed component of X.
Every frozen source-defined transformation, dependency, guard application, interface mapping, readout, or update may be embedded as typed K structure.
The embedding may lose first-class role identity but must not add a new scientific mechanism, hidden coordinator, or new persistent state.
G_POMDP_LIKE: Embed Pi and C as source-defined typing/admissibility information on retained state/interface/transition structure without introducing a new mechanism.
encoding_contract.single_role_ablation: Embed the omitted role distinction as source-defined typing/metadata or retained generic structure; charge A1/A2 only if this requires a new load-bearing mechanism rather than a representation-only recoding.

rowwise_algorithm: Start from each frozen certified MAIN40 A0 row and its source-defined mechanisms.
Apply the comparator encoding contract without deleting or altering source-defined mechanisms.
If the recoding introduces no new load-bearing stateless or persistent mechanism, classify encoding-permissive closure as A0.
If a new stateless load-bearing mechanism is unavoidable, classify A1.
If persistent added state is unavoidable after stateless options, classify A2.
If the available frozen artifacts cannot decide whether a generic encoding exists, return UNDERDETERMINED rather than borrowing the direct-preservation result.

interpretive_split.encoding_permissive_question: Does the weaker basis plus unchanged source mechanisms still reconstruct without added coordination?
interpretive_split.direct_preservation_question: Does the weaker basis keep the declared distinctions first-class without stateless re-exposure?
interpretive_split.rule: Do not use a direct-preservation A1 result as evidence that encoding-permissive A0 fails.

allowed_inference: This control may show that prospective A0 composition is or is not discriminative among representation bases under the original reconstruction-addition semantics.
forbidden_inference: A0 under a weak basis means the weak basis preserves the same first-class distinctions.
Failure of basis discrimination invalidates the prospective no-added-coordinator result.
Any result establishes a unique ontology or a non-encodability theorem.
